Code.description:
The stable error vocabulary. The slug (`snake_case`) is what clients see in
`code`; the HTTP status follows the standard gRPC mapping, plus the two
HTTP-only codes for request bodies.

Detail.description: A typed detail, translated from `google.rpc` error details.

oneOf.description: `google.rpc.RetryInfo`: when to try again; also the `Retry-After` header.

Key.description: The key claims, as `OpenAPI` sees them.

parent.description: The parent key, for a sub-key.

client_id.description: The OAuth client the call came through, if any.

email.description: E-mail address, when the token carries one (a person's ID token does).

oneOf.description: Key and parent key, when minted.

name.description: Display name, when the token carries one.

role.description: Role, when the consent step stamped one.

Problem.description: `{"code","error","details","request_id"}`: the REST body and the SSE `error` payload.

request_id.description:
The request's id, the `x-request-id` the answer carries: name it when
asking about a call. Empty on a socket or MQTT frame, whose own id
names the call.

bearer.description: An access token from the identity provider: a person's, or a customer's from the client credentials grant with an API key (docs.inorbit.hr). The gateway verifies it; the audience is `iohr-api`.

info.description: The routes an API key may call. Every body is JSON; every error is the `Problem` envelope; every route takes a bearer token except the health endpoints.
